## ⭐ Item 7, sharpened — the card's framing understates how tractable it is

The card reads 「Apache-2.0 headers in an MIT-licensed package」 and gives one number (36). Re-measured here with the denominator and the other side:

`packages/types/src/__tests__/` holds **201** test files — **37** carry an Apache-2.0 header, **150** carry the MIT one, **0** carry both, **14** carry neither.

⇒ Apache-2.0 is the **minority drift**, ⛔ not the house convention. That is a materially different question from the one the card asks, and it may not need a maintainer at all. ⛔ This seat still does not rule it, and the order below fences it out as report-only.

## Clause-② — declared **no**, and measured rather than assumed

Item 6's repair replaces module-local type mirrors with an import of `WalkableDef`. The question is whether that needs a new published export.

- `WalkableDef` is `export interface` at `packages/types/src/zod/node-derivation.ts:68`, and is on **no** published barrel: `packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts` reads **0**, `packages/types/src/index.ts` reads **0** — beside lit controls of **29** and **119** `export` occurrences in those same two files.
- ⚠️ The first draw of that probe asked for `packages/types/src/zod/index.ts`, **a path that does not exist** (the barrel is `index.zod.ts`), and returned zero for the target *and* for its control. Two zeros on one instrument is a broken instrument, ⛔ not a reading of absence. Re-drawn above.
- But the repair does not need a barrel: `walkable-def-null-mint-9491.test.ts:52` **already** imports it relatively — `import { internals, type WalkableDef } from '../zod/node-derivation.js'` — and `registry-meta-carry-9102.test.ts:61` already imports from that same module.

⇒ intra-package relative imports that already exist in these files. ⛔ Nothing is added to a published surface, nothing widens an accept set. **`Clause-②: no`**, and ⛔ no `needs:contract-review` carrier is hung. ⚠️ The order requires the dev to STOP and report if any item turns out to need a barrel export after all — that would flip the declaration and is ⛔ not the dev's to decide.

## File face, declared for the in-flight intersection check

`packages/types/src/__tests__/walkable-def-null-mint-9491.test.ts` · `…/imported-defaults-describe-9034.test.ts` · `…/registry-meta-carry-9102.test.ts` · `…/imported-defaults-rest-less-tuple-9088.test.ts` · `.changeset/9491-walkabledef-rest-null.md`.

Checked against all **12** open PRs in this repository. The three that touch `packages/types` — objectui#9688 (`object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts`), objectui#9540 (`objectql.ts`, `objectql.zod.ts`, `object-gallery-filter-9309.test.ts`) and objectui#8941 (38 files, incl. `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`) — intersect **none** of the five. Merge queue was empty at this act. ⇒ no serial constraint.

⚠️ ⛔ **Two of the target files are other cards' pin files** (objectui#9034, objectui#9102, objectui#9088). The order requires their threads to be read before either is edited, and requires the edit to leave each pin asserting exactly what its own card asked it to assert.

## ACCEPT — with two of this seat's own claims refuted by the implementer, and both owned here

`2026-09-17T14:28Z` · PM seat `domain:spec` @ objectui · `Seat: domain:spec#1` · session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L` · `Implemented-by: session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L` (os-dev subagent) · `Reviewed-by: session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L` (PM seat)

PR objectui#9697, head `43de3c8cb64fb29eee4638039da0499fdbffe14e`. ⛔ Enqueue is **held** — see the last section.

## ⛔ This seat's error, first, because it is the most useful thing on this page

**The dispatch order told the implementer the wrong direction, in writing.** [`5715545822`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9692#issuecomment-5715545822) says:

> the local mirror in `registry-meta-carry-9102.test.ts:74-90` is named `ZodDef` and is a *broader* shape than `WalkableDef`

**It is narrower.** Re-measured by this seat on `origin/main` `bbe57fdd5`, member by member:

| interface | members | the difference |
|---|---|---|
| `WalkableDef` (`zod/node-derivation.ts:68`) | **15** | — |
| the module-local `ZodDef` in `registry-meta-carry-9102.test.ts` | **13** | missing **`keyType`** and **`catchall`** |

⇒ importing `WalkableDef` **WIDENS** what that pin's reader type admits; it does not narrow it. The whole caution this seat attached to that instruction — *"verify member-by-member that the import is a true replacement before you make it, and if it is not, leave that mirror alone rather than narrowing someone else's pin"* — was pointed in the wrong direction. The implementer measured it, reported it, and was right.

⚠️ **A second claim of this seat's, on the card face itself, is also refuted.** objectui#9692 item 6 says each mirror *"casts around its own declaration to read the `null` that declaration refuses"*. The implementer measured: with the inaccurate declaration restored **and** the cast dropped, `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` reports **no error at that site**. TypeScript permits comparing a `z.ZodType` to `null` under `strict`. ⇒ the casts were **not compiler-forced**. The conclusion survives — the declaration was inaccurate and the casts are redundant — but **the mechanism this seat asserted is not the mechanism**, and it was asserted without being measured.

⭐ Both are the same failure and it is this seat's: **a plausible mechanism written down as if it had been read.** That is the defect this whole card is about, committed in the document that dispatched it.

## Verified by this seat independently, ⛔ not relayed from the implementer

Head `43de3c8cb`, base `bbe57fdd5`, read `2026-09-17T14:28Z`.

| check | reading |
|---|---|
| diff shape | **6 files**, +184 / −66 — matches the PR body's one-row-per-file table exactly, no row missing |
| item 5 — frontmatter byte-identical | `sha256` of the first three lines: **`f2b3fc6fdce2e33eea6736f6da5112d1f54c02e1`** on base **and** head |
| item 5 — the overclaim | `no other member the walkers read ever is` **1 → 0**; `across the node kinds the pin builds` **0 → 1** |
| item 6 — the inaccurate form | `rest?: z.ZodType;` under `packages/types` on head: **0**, beside a **lit control** of `rest?: z.ZodType \| null` reading **2** files on the same instrument |
| item 6 — the mirrors | `interface ZodDef` remaining in the three target files: **0** |
| the three other cards' pins keep their assertions | `it(`/`test(` at line start, base → head: 9034 **28 → 28** · 9102 **31 → 31** · 9088 **15 → 15** |

⚠️ **The implementer reported those counts as 15 / 28 / 35 and this seat's instrument reads 28 / 31 / 15.** ⛔ Neither is being called wrong: the two instruments count different things (a source grep for `it(`/`test(` at line start vs. what the runner reports, which expands parameterised cases). **The claim that matters — unchanged base to head — holds on this seat's instrument for all three files.** Recorded rather than smoothed over, because quoting two different measurements as if they were one is how a number drifts.

⭐ One more, and it sharpens the widening above: `keyType` and `catchall` read **0** in `registry-meta-carry-9102.test.ts` on **both** base and head. ⇒ the widening is **latent** — the pin does not reference either member, so nothing it asserts moves. That is why no carrier is owed on objectui#9102's thread: its assertions are unchanged, and its reader type merely stopped being a narrower hand-copy.

## Clause-② — this seat concurs: `no`

The implementer re-derived it and went further than the order asked, confirming **both barrel paths EXIST before reading a zero out of them** and adding that `packages/types/package.json`'s `exports` map reaches no `zod/node-derivation` subpath. All new imports are intra-package relative specifiers. ⇒ no published surface moves, no accept set widens. ⛔ **No at-tier contract review is owed**, and ⛔ no `needs:contract-review` carrier is hung.

## The two open questions the implementer handed back

**Item 4 — leave it stopped (its option A). Ruled here, and it is this seat's to rule because it is a filing question, not a contract one.** A census over zod's shipped tree is not one of the three filing classes: not a reproducible defect, not a violation of a declared contract, not an AI-metadata trap. ⇒ 三类外, and the fallback does not hold either — no PR is going to open a dependency's compiled tree on the way past. The substantive half of the reasoning is the implementer's and this seat adopts it: **after item 1, the source half covers only node kinds NEITHER walker names**, i.e. nothing either walker can read. ⛔ No card. The pin file's honesty paragraph is the correct remedy and it is already in the diff.

**Item 7 — stays with the maintainer, unchanged.** The implementer also reconciled the discrepancy between its reading and this seat's rather than picking one: **201** files under `packages/types/src/__tests__/`, of which **200** are `*.test.*` and the 201st is `zod-subpath-single-module-8598.dist.spec.tsx`; among the 200, Apache-2.0 **37** / MIT **149** / both **0** / neither **14**, and counting all 201 the MIT figure is **150** — which is exactly this seat's number, and the one file is the whole difference. ⛔ Nothing was ruled and no header was touched.

## ⛔ Enqueue is HELD — CI is not green yet

Read on head `43de3c8cb` at `2026-09-17T14:28Z`: **0 failures**, and **5 jobs still running** — `Test (shard 1/4)` through `(4/4)` and `Type Check`. Everything else has completed green, including `Lint`, `Build & E2E`, `Build Docs`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Overwrite Report` and `Live E2E (informational)`.

⛔ Zero failures is **not** a green reading while five required jobs are in flight. The PR stays **draft** until all five complete `success`, read from `/commits/<sha>/check-runs` on the head re-read from the PR object — ⛔ not from an aggregate, ⛔ not from a `check_suite.completed` event, which excludes cancelled suites.

⚠️ `Test (shard n/4)` has run **1181s / 1192s / 1217s / 1167s** against `timeout-minutes: 20` (1200s) on this board today — one of those was a cancellation at the ceiling. PR objectui#9584's 4→8 reshard is the real fix and is still open. If a shard is cancelled at the ceiling on this head, that is the explicitly re-runnable category **only** if the job died before any test body ran; ⛔ otherwise it is read as a real failure.

Then: ready → enqueue, confirmed **positively by the queue ref** `refs/heads/gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-9697-BASESHA` against the ~12,600-ref lit control — ⛔ never the `auto_merge` field, which reads back unstable by design.

## ⭐ NEW PLATFORM READING — a queue-ref probe fired too early reads a FALSE ZERO

This is the trap, measured in sequence on this act:

| moment | queue-ref probe | lit control (total refs) |
|---|---|---|
| **~6 s** after the enqueue `PUT` returned `200` with body `{"enabled":true,"merge_method":"squash"}` | **0 refs** | **12,604** |
| ~30 s later | **1 ref** — `refs/heads/gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-9697-dd871fc080f24f55bbc53bfeac6e837a5bc03266` | 12,604 |

⇒ **the queue ref is not created synchronously with the enqueue call.** A single immediate probe reading zero against a healthy control is indistinguishable, at that moment, from a failed enqueue — and the obvious wrong move is to re-issue the `PUT`. ⛔ The positive queue-ref probe is still the right judge; it just has to be **given time and re-read**, and a first zero is ⛔ not a verdict.

Two more from the same sequence, both confirming existing ledger lines rather than adding to them:

- `auto_merge` reads back **`None`** while the PR is demonstrably in the queue. ⛔ Never the judge.
- The `ready_for_review` endpoint returned `200`; the flip was nonetheless confirmed by a `GET` reading `draft: False`, ⛔ not by the status code.

⚠️ **`main` moved under this act**, `bbe57fdd52` → `dd871fc08`, between the two probes — another lane landed. The queue ref's base is the **new** tip, and `mergeable_state` re-read `clean`. ⇒ nothing owed, but it is why the queue ref's BASESHA is not the base this PR was opened against.

## One edit to the PR body before readying, and why

The 维护者速读 ended 「本 PR 停在 draft,⛔ 未入队、未翻 ready」 — true of the implementer's hand-off, and about to become false. This repository's **squash commit message carries the full PR body verbatim**, so that sentence would have landed in `main`'s history as a false statement about the very commit carrying it. It was rewritten to past tense with the reason stated inline. ⛔ Nothing else in the body was touched; the diff is unchanged and the head did not move, so the review record above is **not** void.

⚠️ Sent with **zero** trailing footers — a `PATCH` carrying a body unconditionally appends one (measured again here: 13,577 sent → 13,635 stored, +58 = exactly one footer). Read back: exactly one.
